translation.name: GOT WENG ABEM Alokso Abino Kalin

content: Kaleyo kamane Got ayo ulum kano kuek di alam am finkanin bakan kuyamokabino, kalba, ayo weng takadáyaba kala. Kaleyo be kidela ata bomo kala, masi yak kan kawta Got weng ibik wakudawono, kanabaw kaba masi Got alam weng kanoyamokabi, kalba uyo gew takomamodaw kala.

Naka umi mit bakan bom nadi “nuka be kidela uta bom naduwo ko.” Kalbi be wataw ata bá, Got weng nulum abál mit imi kidimamsiw sung kidel alataw ki nukul nuluso kidibuw kala kale ika kidimsiw, kata mak dakoyamongin banim keisu. Watawo kaleyo bá, ika kilung tem bo kidibiw kata, ika aket tem Got be afan kalongin banim kayo ko.
Kale nuka yak finkanin bakan unokabuw, be nulum afan kalin dim yak unokabuw. Kale be Got alata bako,

content.text: “naka aket kus keinama atin kitid weng kuw bako, ‘ika atin yak nam finkanin bakan bo unodiw báno.’”

content: Kalesa. Be finkanin bakan bo kidel kudongin banim kayo bá, kata bo dil suwayo katow kal adikum ufek ufek kidel dausa kal ukal kidel kusa.
Kale alam buk tem uyo am fet kal umi sung bako, “Got aka am bokuw dim kal wok adik wakadála banima nade fet dim kal finusano.” Kalesu.
Kale sung anung kaw tam bakodi uyo bako, “ika atin yak nam finkanin bakan bo unodiw báno.” Kalesa.

Kaleyo be ken madik ika lukbala wakas yak Got ami finkanin bakan unodiw ka. Kamakikiw kinim wanang Got weng finkanin sung kidisidiw, ika bo kudulongin banim, watawo kaleyo bá, ika Got aket afan kalongin banim kayo ko.

Kata yak madik ika ken finkanin bo ken kudulodiw ka. Watawo kaleyo bá, Got aka atan mak kuti win takumam, “Kamano” kalesa. Suwayo itol deng mak banimsa katow kal am bemi sung uyo Dewit dim kal bakosa, kale bako,

content.text: “kiba kamano atan uyo Got weng kidiliw namti, kudámin bá.”

content: Kale nulum kal Yosuwa aka wanang kinim bo bakadu kudew yak kanodin finkanin bakan bo unse bá. Watawo kaleyo bá, nuka nulum kal keidomo Got aka alo um atan bo banimune, alo am kukum mak kawákal umi sung bo bakosa.
Naka nalam kano mew bakoyami, be afan Got ami wanang kinim ika finkanin mak ulum kano bu bo dil alam ufek ufek kidel ku nada atan fet dim finusa taw kala.
Kale kan ata yak Got am finkanin kudulokaba, be alam wok fakusa, kayo yak kal finudokaba be kano Got alam ufek ufek kidel kudá yanol finusa taw keidokaba.

Kaleyo nuka kidela kitid tabe abo naduwo kata kanodin finkanin uyo kudulum kala, kale masi kinim mak yak finkanin bo gew takomamodaw banim keidal kala kale dil imi kanamsiw taw keidoluw banim, ika ilim afan kalin banim kayo make.

Kale Got ami weng be kitid ade sinik so kayo ufek ufek ken kanamoma. Kale woksek kinang madik kinang madik fidá ausu bo ken dam tem wakela yak kun kuek dimin so kun so wakel kudoma, kata Got ami weng bo woksek atud kanodin bo akamamsu kayo aka yak num aket tem kal bom nada sinik weng bakaya bom nada num aket fukanin so kukuw yaknámumo kalbuw so uyo taktakyamá bom yaknámin uta kidel yaknámin uta mafak yakanába kala.
Got am kin bá be bo ufek ufek adikum misun kalám gu ki bu ade yakodin uta mak akidongin banim. Kayo nuka nulum kukuw adikum kanamusuw uyo kidela dákafi bakodawum kala.
Yesus ata atin num bokal kayak dukum umi sung uta ko.
Kale kidela nulum afan kalin dinang bakabuw uyo kidela fakudumo. Watawo kaleyo bá, Got Min Yesus ayo tam Got alam kin dim nulum bokal kayak dukum keise kayo kala.
Kale num bokal kayak aka ken num ban keimin kinkino yakin kinim, aka leiw adikum bo ban keimin ta bom num aket takoyamono kanabu taw kanadawsu, kata aka ban mak keidongin banim keise.

Kale nuka fingánin banim kei naduwe wakala dula unom naduwo yak Got ami abin abem min kukáyamin abin unuwo aket budunin dauyam nadano nulum imkuku budu kan ata watakoyamake, kalbuw uyo ata dakoyamak kala.
